summary: Separate English and Tajik discovery identified Geoportal.tj, national land/cadastre custodians, and a local district land-management committee. Geoportal HTTP redirected to HTTPS, where normal TLS verification failed on an expired certificate. Reachable official pages exposed no anonymous parcel geometry. No safe native parcel ID-plus-polygon response was qualified.
custodian: The State Committee for Land Management and Geodesy is national custodian evidence; the Ghafurov district committee is local administrative evidence. Neither yielded a functioning city-local public parcel geometry service.
requests: English/Tajik searches, Geoportal HTTPS and redirect checks, official national pages, official registration list, local district site and local land-management committee page are recorded in the city record. No TLS bypass, credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or unsafe owner/contact/titleholder fields were used.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only if source-proven
full parcel polygon geometry only when safely returned
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [40.2412381197989, 69.7455871108815] and population 183812 persons are preserved.
TLS failure, unavailable viewer, or no exact-point response is not treated as citywide absence.
No raw source-specific attributes or GeoJSON sample were retained.
Packet completion is not source integration/admission.
uncertainty: Geoportal data may be available after certificate remediation or through another official route; no exception was used.
Native parcel IDs, CRS, polygons and citywide coverage remain unverified.
The official registration list and local committee page are not substitutes for a parcel geometry service.
